actions.name: human_review_on_existing_record
actions.title: Assign task to users
actions.description: Assign a task to users in a workflow app and wait until completed
actions.help: Use this action to create and assign a workflow task to a user or user group. Assignee receives an email to complete task (approve, reject, etc.) in a custom app page. The recipe waits until the task is completed or expires.

input.name: app_id
input.label: Workflow app
input.hint: Choose a workflow app to assign task in.

input.name: record_id
input.label: Record ID
input.hint: Choose a request (identified by Record ID ) to create user task for. Use a data pill or enter the exact ID.

input.name: workflow_stage_id
input.label: Workflow stage
input.hint: Choose a workflow stage to change to while waiting for the task to be completed. If left empty, the stage will remain the same.

input.name: name
input.label: Task name
input.hint: Describe what needs to be done. Task name will be displayed in email subject lines. Use datapills to personalize it.

input.name: user_group_id
input.label: Assignee
input.hint: Choose a user group to assign the task to.

input.name: page_id
input.label: Page
input.hint: Choose from existing pages or create a new page for assignees to complete the task in.

input.name: due_in_days
input.label: Number of days to complete task
input.hint: Tasks expire if they aren't completed within the specified timeframe. Maximum value is 370 days.

input.name: share_when_completes
input.label: Share request with the user who completes the task

input.name: reassignable
input.label: Allow assignee to reassign task
input.hint: Manager can still reassign task
